AI Career Companion

Open Prototype
TypeAI career guidance platform
Designed withFigma
ForStudents & job seekers

Guidance that turns a career journey into clear next steps.

AI Career Companion is an AI-powered career guidance platform designed to help students and job seekers navigate their career journeys. It provides personalized career recommendations, skill gap analysis, resume insights, job opportunities, and learning roadmaps based on individual skills, interests, and career goals.

The platform focuses on creating a user-friendly experience that makes career planning smarter, easier, and more accessible.
